The lighting is dramatic against a black background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The hair lacks fine strand definition, appearing as fused, plastic-like tubes or clumps rather than individual fibers. This is a common AI artifact in rendering dense hair.

The orange/brown patches on the face look like melted wax or poorly rendered textures. They lack clear boundaries and seem to blend unnaturally into the skin tone, suggesting a generation error in the facial details.
Slight softness and lack of definition at the bottom edge of the face, potentially indicating difficulty in grounding the subject against the dark background.
